INSERT INTO token_caches (
            token_jti,
            cache_id,
            pattern
        )
        SELECT
            $1,
            CASE WHEN entry LIKE 'id:%' THEN SUBSTR(entry, 4)::int END,
            CASE WHEN entry NOT LIKE 'id:%' THEN entry END
        FROM UNNEST($2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS requested(entry, position)
        ORDER BY position
